name: OpenCode Go
description: Serves an OpenCode Go subscription through CLIProxyAPI: the Go models of a workspace over Chat Completions, Messages and Responses, the workspace's opt-in OpenCode Zen pay-as-you-go models as opencode/..., OpenCode's free models as opencode-free/... with no account at all, each with a priority and weight of its own, an OpenCode login from the OAuth Login page or keys on a Management Center page that also enables and disables models, one setting that serves every model under its bare ID to share it with other providers, and 5-hour, weekly and monthly quota in the Plugin tab.
author: Whexy
